{{Quote|Until this week, the greatest defensive weapon the Alliance safeworld of Maldra IV had was secrecy. This protection was snatched from the thousands of noncombatant personnel living in the colony earlier this week when Imperial forces appeared in the skies of Maldra IV and rained death down on the defenseless.|An [[Alderaan Expatriate Network]] report|<ref name="GNN10" />}}
A '''battle''' at [[Maldra IV]] took place in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Briera]]'s [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']] moved into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the planet [[Maldra IV]] to investigate reports of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] but discovered the base actually belonged to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Maldra IV was in fact a Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] and was home to thousands of refugees. The base was defended by a regional [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], two [[Planetary ion cannon|ion cannons]] and a token force of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The fighters were all shot by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and the shields resisted five hours until being destroyed by [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial Army special operatives]]. The Rebel refugees managed to transmit a holorecord of the attack before the base was razed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. This record was later used to counter the Imperial propaganda. Indeed, the Empire claimed the base was an important Rebel training base and all the Rebels sacrificed themselves, rather than be taken alive, by detonating the munitions plant and killing [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of stormtroopers.
